To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the optimization of the workforce management problem can be achieved by the application of a multi-objective optimization model with a utility function based on interactions of the goals.

the application of a multi-goal optimization model to workforce management is a feasible approach and that the application of the multi-goal optimization model is superior to the application of the single-goal model.
the interaction between goals is important for the quality of results, that it can be used to improve results, and that it is not possible to find a general approach that works in all cases.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development and application of an optimization method that can handle partly conflicting goals and is applicable to complex real world problems.
the development of a model and its implementation in an optimization software for solving real world multi-goal resource planning problems with partly conflicting goals.
the question how a multi-goal optimization problem can be modeled in order to find optimal results that are consistent with the problem and the optimization goals.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the application of the model to workforce management shows the applicability of the model in real world problems.
the model presented here is a useful approach to solve multi-goal optimization problems.
the approach of goal interactions is able to handle complex real-world optimization problems.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the optimization model based on the interaction between goals is able to find solutions which are better than solutions of the model with weighted sum of goals.
we show how to model the optimization problem of resource planning in a way that it allows for the management of the partly conflicting optimization goals.
the interaction between goals is a key for the optimization of partly conflicting goals in complex resource planning.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the optimization of partly conflicting goals can be achieved by the use of an optimization model that takes into account the interactions between goals and the use of the concept of a Pareto front as solution concept.
the optimization goals can be modeled as a set of partly conflicting goals that interact with each other in a complex way.
the interaction between goals can help to achieve better solutions than the weighted sum approach.
